title: spectrum/1: one spectrum, `mzlab-cli spectrum get`
description: The spectrum at an RT window or a scan. x is m/z. CSV (`--format csv`) has the header mz,intensity. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/spectrum_cmd.rs.

sample.description: Sample id of a multi-sample file (.wiff); null for an mzML.

points.description: [x, y] pairs; the number tokens are the page route's own bytes.

evidence.description: query (the route query), scan (scan_id, scan_no, rt_min, ms_level), answer (the route's own members) and, only when --ms-level was absent and the file's only MS level is not 1, level_auto; with --sum, `sum` (n_scans, counts_cps, fill_time, ions, by_scan_type, ion_quantum, ions_by_quantum, background: the bytes of /api/specsum); with --peak auto, `peak` (the bytes of /api/specpeak without its lines: verdict, rule, flags, params, search_min, trace, apex, fwhm_min, window_min, sides, background, n_scans, total_ions, sum); in the mean of a window of two scans or more, `hint` (key, text, command) names --sum.

level_auto.description: Present only when --ms-level was absent and the file's only MS level is not 1: the level that was used and why.
